scoring_justification: Recomputing DFT total energies in the verifier is infeasible; compare reported energy curve and spin values to paper gold with tolerances.

outputs.description: Comma-separated table with header containing Δd (displacement in Å) and ΔE_MEC (magnetoelectric coupling energy change in meV per unit cell) for the five target displacements.
Plain text file with two lines giving the net majority spin (in electrons per S atom) on bridging sulfur atoms at Δd=0 and Δd=0.44 Å.

output_contract.notes: The DFT protocol uses the PBE+U functional with van der Waals correction (DFT-D3) and spin polarization. The reference values for ΔE_MEC and spin polarization are compared against paper-reported quantities; tolerances accommodate method-dependent variations across equivalent DFT codes (e.g., Quantum ESPRESSO).

steps.description: Check that ΔE_MEC values are non-increasing as Δd increases.
Compare ΔE_MEC at five specified displacements to paper gold within ±0.05 meV.
Compare spin polarization values to paper gold within ±0.01 e-/S.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference ΔE_MEC values and spin polarization from the paper
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Fig. 4 and text: ΔE_MEC values: 0, -0.15, -0.20, -0.32, -0.37 meV at Δd = 0, 0.29, 0.44, 1.0, 1.69 Å. Spin polarization: 0.135 e-/S for Δd=0, 0.092 e-/S for Δd=0.44 Å.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from paper description and Figure 4b.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are directly reported in the paper; they are the target the reproduction must match.
